if-statement-breaks: handles conditionally broken execution

supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js
loop-errors: does not break flow from inside loops that may not have executed
handle-try-catch: include properties through try-catch calls
safest: handles treeshake preset "safest"
invalid-property-calls: includes invalid property calls
optional-catch-binding: allows optional catch binding
assignment: checks side effects when reassigning namespace members
catch-block-scope: uses correct scope in catch blocks
global-calls: tracks argument mutations of calls to globals
cannot-call-external-namespace: warns if code calls an external namespace
missing-spaces-after-simplification: handle situations where the simplification of an expression can lead to issues due to missing white-space
supports-es6-shim: supports es6-shim
hoisted-declarations: includes hoisted declarations when control flow is broken
thrown-errors: breaks control flow when an error is thrown
invalid-property-assignments: includes invalid property assignments
